description: Ridership per day per time slot is a dataset listed in Tpg open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Analytical Unit - tpg Exploitation. Nombre d'usagers qui montent dans un véhicule par tranche horaire et par jour. Ces valeurs concernent toutes les lignes du réseau et tous les arrêts sans distinction entre la zone suisse et la zone française. Il s'agit des valeurs enregistrées dans les capteurs en haut des portes de chaque véhicule, successivement consolidées dans nos systèmes. Coverage: Geneva (tpg network). The portal files it under Ridership. Its keywords are Ridership, Boarding Passengers, Time Slot. The portal shows 65,737 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-tpg-ch-portal.
